caption: Radio Kootwijk
composition: Concrete transmitter hall, square tower, and a squat dome on open heath · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Building A at Radio Kootwijk stands alone on open Veluwe heath: a reinforced-concrete hall with a square tower and a low overhanging dome. A cooling pond lies in front. The sky is clear, about 12.8°C, with wind near 8.6 km/h. It is concrete, not brick, and it is not a church. No lettering is readable. This is not the Kröller-Müller Museum at Otterlo.
